object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

$assignedUser has submitted a draft of the $referenceName source configuration. You will be able to approve their configurations or request changes. You can then publish the draft to create a source.

Go to the $referenceName configuration page to review this draft.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies the assigner when they have a review to approve by a collaborator who is configuring a source
object.name: Source Collaboration Review Notification
object.subject: $assignedUser has submitted a draft of the $referenceName source
